  event orientation;
- included row scope, controls, baselines, endpoints, missing values, and
  replicate handling;

# Galaxy UDT Templates And Troubleshooting

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

For generated glue scripts, avoid nested `python -c` quoting. A base64 argument
keeps the script as one shell token:

```bash
SCRIPT_B64='BASE64_WITHOUT_NEWLINES'
python -c 'import base64, pathlib, sys; pathlib.Path("job.py").write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[1]))' "$SCRIPT_B64"
python job.py "$(inputs.inpu

import csv, os
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
key=Path(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read_text().strip()

gi.datasets.download_dataset('f9cad7b01a47213575bec0cb75a24ad3', file_path=str(out), use_default_filename=False)
with out.open(newline='') as f:
    rows=list(csv.reader(f, delimiter='\\t'))
header=rows[0]
eff_i=header.index('Efficacy')
bmi_i=header.index('BMI')
eff=Counter(r[eff_i] for r in rows[1:])
missing_eff=sum(r[eff_i].strip()=='' for r in rows[1:])
missing_bmi=sum(r[bmi_i].strip()=='' for r in rows[1:])
invalid_bmi=sum((r[bmi_i].strip()"'!='"'' and not _is_float(r[bmi_i])) for r in rows[1:]) if False else None
bad=[]
vals=[]
for r in rows[1:]:

    try: vals.append(float(s))

print({'rows':len(rows)-1,'header_columns':len(header),'efficacy_counts':dict(eff),'missing_efficacy':missing_eff,'missing_bmi':missing_bmi,'invalid_bmi_values':sorted(set(bad)),'bmi_min':min(vals),'bmi_max':max(vals)})

representation.name: BMI sole-predictor logistic AIC for efficacy PR
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > fit.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
d <- read.delim(args[[1]], header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
required <- c("Efficacy", "BMI")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) stop("Required columns not found")
eff <- trimws(as.character(d[["Efficacy"]]))
bmi_text <- trimws(as.character(d[["BMI"]]))
keep <- nzchar(eff) & nzchar(bmi_text)
eff <- eff[keep]
bmi <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(bmi_text[keep]))
if (anyNA(bmi)) stop("Non-numeric BMI in analysis rows")
allowed <- c("PR", "SD", "PD")
if (!all(eff %in% allowed)) stop("Unexpected efficacy category")
efficacy_pr <- as.integer(eff == "PR")
model_data <- data.frame(efficacy_pr = efficacy_pr, BMI = bmi)
fit <- glm(efficacy_pr ~ BMI, data = model_data, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
ll <- as.numeric(logLik(fit))
out <- data.frame(
  method = "unpenalized binomial GLM with logit link",
  formula = "I(Efficacy == PR) ~ BMI",
  non_event = "SD or PD",
  n = nrow(model_data),
  pr_events = sum(efficacy_pr),
  non_pr_events = sum(1L - efficacy_pr),
  parameters = length(coef(fit)),
  converged = fit$converged,
  log_likelihood = format(ll, digits = 17, scientific = FALSE),
  AIC = format(AIC(fit), digits = 17, scientific = FALSE),
  check.names = FALSE
)
write.table(out, file = "result.tsv", sep = "	", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript fit.R "$(inputs.input.path)"
